description: Source code for Odoo modules related to manufacturing and workcenter operations, including classes for stock moves, production lines, and operations management.

classes.name: stock_move
classes.description: Extends stock.move with a one2many relation for child moves and a custom copy method.

classes.name: mrp_production_workcenter_line
classes.description: Represents workcenter lines in manufacturing, with methods for state transitions, date calculations, and workflow triggers.

classes.name: mrp_production
classes.description: Extends manufacturing orders with planning, movement, and state management functionalities.

classes.name: mrp_operations_operation_code
classes.description: Defines operation codes with start/stop statuses for manufacturing operations.

classes.name: mrp_operations_operation
classes.description: Manages manufacturing operations, including creation, validation, delay calculation, and workflow integration.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Overrides copy to reset child move relations.

methods.name: _get_date_date
methods.description: Calculates start date in date format.

methods.name: _get_date_end
methods.description: Calculates end date based on planned date and timesheet intervals.

methods.name: modify_production_order_state
methods.description: Transitions production order states based on actions.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Overrides write to update start dates and plan workcenter lines.

methods.name: action_draft
methods.description: Sets workcenter line to draft.

methods.name: action_start_working
methods.description: Starts work on a workcenter line and updates production state.

methods.name: action_done
methods.description: Marks workcenter line as done, calculates delay, and updates production.

methods.name: action_cancel
methods.description: Cancels a workcenter line.

methods.name: action_pause
methods.description: Pauses a workcenter line.

methods.name: action_resume
methods.description: Resumes a paused workcenter line.

methods.name: _production_date_end
methods.description: Calculates production end date based on workcenter lines.

methods.name: action_production_end
methods.description: Ends production and triggers workflow.

methods.name: action_in_production
methods.description: Sets production to in progress and triggers workflow.

methods.name: action_cancel
methods.description: Cancels production and triggers workflow.

methods.name: _compute_planned_workcenter
methods.description: Computes and updates planned dates for workcenter lines.

methods.name: _move_pass
methods.description: Adjusts start dates for passed production orders.

methods.name: _move_futur
methods.description: Adjusts start dates for future production orders.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Overrides write to handle date and workcenter line planning.

methods.name: action_compute
methods.description: Computes planning for production.

methods.name: calc_delay
methods.description: Calculates delay based on operation start/stop codes and times.

methods.name: check_operation
methods.description: Validates operation state transitions based on codes.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new operation, manages workflow triggers, and updates production lines.
